## Project Goals and Objectives

This project is a minimum-value product for an agentic brokerage as a proof of concept for further developments of more dedicated and focused trading platforms. It is a prompt-first mobile brokerage where every action - research, charting, trading, alerts, risk audits - is a prompt that generates a personalised widget that can be pinned to a dashboard. Functionalities include authenticated email login, connection to IBKR and Snaptrade portfolios, research on US-focused tickers and TradingView charting.

## Process and Approach

- Provided initial outline of agentic brokerage, which includes repository architecture, backend agent loop, frontend shell, security, Anthropic prompt, Alpaca adapter, and execution widgets.
- Expanded on research tools such as Yahoo Finance, TradingView MCP and FMP research into backend for usage in execution widgets.
- Applied persistence for chat functionality. 
- Supabase Auth/RLS created to ensure user authentication for app.
- Implemented PostHog and Langfuse for Bottom of Funnel (BOFU) application analysis
- Set up connections for IBKR Flex portfolio without enabling trading, and briefing generation and delivery through Twilio to WhatsApp and email; Alpaca was also implemented as alternative portfolio as proof-of-concept.
- Updated IBKR portfolio implementation to be by per-user rather than shared across all users for security purposes.
- Improved delivery channels and chat rendering in UI, added HK technicals/charts, news, image input, conversation memory, and portfolio visualisations.
- Applied new LLM provider rails into backend to act as backups for token usage limits, trust validation, more transparent error messaging on UX.
- Created SnapTrade portfolio connection as alternative to IBKR (which allows for connections to various brokers, including IBKR itself); trading remains unavailable.
- Confirmed and further reinforced Supabase account selection and per-user isolation.

## Evaluation and Future Improvements

- Splitting the `agent-broker-original-stage` into separate repositories would allow for more clarity for changes made in each commit; current format is due to being deliberate beta for other projects and thus for preservation.
- Chat costs rack up rapidly, may want to consider cheaper LLM providers for API backend.
- Waitlist presently provides no functionality beyond recording provided email into Supabase.
- Twilio connection is on lower-tier plan and thus has to be reestablished on regular basis.
- Langfuse connection with `agent-broker-original` still needs to be repaired.
